name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump says oil prices will come down after midterm elections
changes.summary: President Donald Trump, in an exchange with reporters before traveling to Dallas for the midterm Republican convention, added that he believes Iran will finally relent after the pivotal elections are held in the U.S.

changes.title: Oil Hits $100 a Barrel as Turmoil Intensifies in Middle East
changes.summary: The cost of crude has risen 40 percent since the start of the war in Iran, pushing up the price of gasoline, diesel and other refined fuels.

changes.title: Trump’s Midterm Pitch Clouded by Iran War and Canada Tariffs
changes.summary: A worsening trade war and a spike in oil prices could create new economic risks as the president prepares to rally Republicans for the midterms.

changes.title: Why Trump Is Gathering Republicans in Texas, and Iran Targets U.S. Warships
changes.summary: Plus, the fake images flooding real estate listings.

changes.title: Iran’s Strikes on Base in Jordan Caused Limited Damage, U.S. Officials Say
changes.summary: The latest round of fighting may result in reports of traumatic brain injuries among American service members, officials warned.

changes.title: Goldman Sachs warns oil prices could hit $120 as U.S. fuel costs surge
changes.summary: Higher gas and diesel prices have cost Americans an additional $100 billion since the Iran war began, according to a Brown University tracker.

changes.title: Why Stocks Are Defying Gravity and What Could Bring Them Down
changes.summary: Investors are focused on strong corporate earnings and A.I., while looking past the war in Iran. But rising interest rates are an increasing risk to the rally.

changes.title: Saudi Arabia and Yemen’s Houthis Edge Back to the Brink of War
changes.summary: The Saudi authorities said dozens were injured in attacks by the Iran-backed militia and vowed to retaliate.

changes.title: Canada Trade War Escalates; Rising Fuel Prices Impact Americans
changes.summary: Canadian retaliatory tariffs on some 700 American products are going into effect as the trade war intensifies. It comes less than two months until the November midterms, with the ongoing war with Iran, tariffs and spiking gas prices on the minds of American voters. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

changes.title: Houthis strike Saudi Arabian cities in significant expansion of Middle East war
changes.summary: Riyadh says it will retaliate after overnight attacks by Iran-backed Yemen group on oil facilities wound more than 70 Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis have attacked four cities in Saudi Arabia, wounding more than 70 people and setting oil installations ablaze in what appeared to be a significant expansion of the Middle East.
